title: Knowledge set
description: A selection of items, itself an item: the unit of knowledge transfer between stores, and usable as a reading list. Shallow means the members (and members of nested sets); deep also follows every reference from them, recursively. A primary item: frozen once written.

members.description: The items selected (refs; they need not be in this store).

depth.description: shallow: the members only; deep: the members and everything they reference, recursively.

nested.description: When a member (or a reference reached deeply) is itself a knowledge set: follow its own depth, or inherit this set's.

follow.description: Reference fields a deep descent follows (default: all of them).

purpose.description: What the set is for: transfer, reading-list, release ...
